description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Analysis of Vertical Accelerations of Mass Timber Floor Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joel Conte, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). The purpose of this research is to investigate the dynamic behavior of the mass timber floor systems in a six-story building. The research investigates responses to factors of self-weight, ramp acceleration, and actual ground motion using an Extended Three-Dimensional Analysis of Building Systems (ETABS) model. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gs8m-jp89. Keywords: NHERI LHPOST 6, Cross-laminated Timber, Mass Timber, Vertical Acceleration. Published 2023-09-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
